base_address: Defined at SoC level; offsets given relative to module base.
notes: PSI5 is a two-wire current-loop sensor protocol; it does not define a software register map as a protocol concept. The ECU-side PSI5 controller exposes implementation-defined configuration for the loop (operating mode synchronous/asynchronous, sync-pulse period, time-slot assignment, bit rate 125/189 kbps, telegram length, CRC/parity selection); the sensor's own configuration is sensor-specific.

fields: Number of time slots / sensors on the loop
Per-slot offset relative to the sync pulse
